does_not_cover: No split criterion such as entropy or variance reduction is ever computed; best split is assumed by fiat.
The promised missing-data and clustering sequel is absent, so evaluation stops at a toy out-of-bag sketch.
A four-sample demo with six shown trees cannot support any claim about real forest accuracy or tuning.
notes: Fast upbeat demo pacing; decision-tree basics are a stated prerequisite, not taught. Out-of-bag accuracy estimation is evaluation machinery: teaches knowledge-sad-l11-evaluation — reassignment signal.
